g.desc: SkillMerge v16: order can change a finite score; reversal alone cannot improve the symmetric cohort
Same 309 exposed tasks / 22,794 ordered pairs. Exact equal-task means; no model histories or independent trials.
Capacity 1 left/right exact = 0.396211; not shown in zoom.
Grey: annotation-aware achievable-order bounds, not a deployable policy
C Every left-union failure receives one diagnosis (same pair denominator at every capacity)
Cap3: 1,277 failures reverse successfully, yet reversing all pairs gives exact mean equality; real skill effect remains null.
